note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Let the operator change what production works on
purpose: The operator should be able to change what production works on from the production page: which Projects are included, their order and which Plan each runs. These are light preferences that can change until a session starts, and are then locked in with a receipt.
serves: The Project outcome of the operator steering the work without editing records by hand.
done_when: The operator changes a Project's order or Plan on the production cards, each change previews first, and each started Action shows when it was locked in.
reading_note: Draft: none of the 4 Actions has started. They wait for operator Decisions 0115 and 0116 and a related amendment before they start.

actions.title: Record which projects production works on and in what order
actions.why: A saved preference lets the operator change production's queue without editing the system directly.
actions.done_when: A preview-then-apply command changes the included Projects, their order and their Plan, and every change carries a revision check and a receipt.

actions.title: Pick production's next action from the saved preferences
actions.why: Makes the saved preferences drive what starts, and records why each choice was made.
actions.done_when: Each admission takes the next ready Action from the preferred Plan, moves to the same Project's next Plan if that one waits on the operator, and writes a receipt saying why.

actions.title: Add queue controls to the production cards
actions.why: Lets the operator include, stop, move or switch a Project's Plan from the screen where it is shown.
actions.done_when: Each card offers include or stop, move to top with undo, and run a different Plan, and each states its consequence before it applies.

actions.title: Show why a project is not running and when its action was locked in
actions.why: Explains a Project's status at a glance, without asking the operator to read logs.
actions.done_when: A card that is not running shows its latest skip reason, a running card shows when its Action was locked in, and predictions are dimmed when older than two minutes.
